blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A clear understanding of the exam pattern and syllabus is crucial for effective preparation.
Consistently analyzing Previous Years' Questions (PYQs) helps identify high-yield topics.
Integrating static conceptual learning with current affairs builds a strong foundation.
Regular mock tests and timed revisions improve accuracy and manage exam stress.

blocks.content: A clear understanding of the exam pattern and syllabus is crucial for effective preparation.

items: Always verify the weightage of static versus dynamic questions from recent exam trends.
Pay strict attention to negative marking schemes during practice tests.
